system.name: DocFusion
system.one_liner: A 0.28B-parameter generative model that does layout analysis, table recognition, OCR and math expression recognition with one decoder, trained with GK-CEL.

content.variant_note: input, model and output columns: four sample inputs with coloured task tokens funnel into one grey model container (image encoder and embedding layer into one decoder) and fan out to four same-coloured output boxes
content.argues: One small encoder-decoder, steered only by a task token, serves four document parsing tasks, with no separate Transformer encoder for the instruction.
content.subject: DocFusion's architecture with its four task inputs, task tokens and real output strings

lessons.what_to_learn: For a unified multi-task model, give each task one colour and keep it on the input frame, the task token, the legend bar and the output box, and let thin curves converge into and fan out of one model container, so one architecture visibly serves several tasks.
lessons.suits: unified or multi-task models (OCR, detection, instruction-tuned models) where one set of weights handles several task types chosen by a token.

evidence: The model comprises three key components: a visual encoder, a text embedding layer and a Transformer decoder.
no Transformer encoder is included, task-specific prompts are directly embedded, simplifying the architecture

summary: DocFusion is a 0.28B-parameter generative model that handles four document parsing tasks (layout analysis, table recognition, OCR and math expression recognition) with one decoder, trained with a Gaussian-kernel cross-entropy loss so that discrete text tokens and continuous coordinates share one output sequence. Figure 1 is an input, model and output diagram. Four sample inputs (a page, a table, a text block, a formula) are each joined by a plus sign to a coloured task token. Thin curves lead into a grey DocFusion container, where a dual-attention image encoder and an embedding layer produce visual-feature and text-embedding token strips that merge into one Transformer decoder. Four same-coloured boxes show real outputs: location tokens, a LaTeX table, plain text and a LaTeX formula.
summary_zh: DocFusion 用一个解码器统一处理版面分析、表格识别、OCR 和公式识别。图一按输入、模型、输出三栏排布：四种样本各配一个彩色任务标记，经图像编码器与文本嵌入层汇入 Transformer 解码器，再按同色输出四类结果。
notes: Prior label model-anatomy kept; stage-pipeline (fan-out of one model to four tasks) added as secondary. The figure has no framed or lettered panels, so the three titled columns are recorded as lanes and section markers. The two sets of curved arrows over the encoder cubes (navy and yellow) are not explained in the figure or the quoted text. Whether the plus sign means concatenation or only pairing is not stated.
